detail.longDescription: Netlify Server gives your app a backend that stays alive while people are using it. Build realtime experiences, multiplayer games, and AI agents that need time to finish. Describe what you want and an agent builds it, or bring your Express, Fastify, Hono, or Koa code. It holds WebSockets open, keeps state in memory, and deploys with the rest of your project, with its own server for every preview. Scales with demand and down to zero when idle. Free during early access.
